d:
Everything in AI looks like an idea right now which is exactly the problem. This video turns Y Combinator's latest Requests for Startups into a timeline of where AI will actually eat the economy, layer by layer, so you can pick a battlefield instead of a buzzword.
Four waves - services, the physical world, infrastructure, and software and for each one: where AI has leverage, what business you'd really be running, and how hard it actually is. By the end the question isn't "is AI big." It's which layer is actually yours.
